- Updated SKILL.md documentation to reflect new version and minor refinements.

- Workflow no longer requires users to provide or be prompted for open-id; identification is now handled entirely internally by the system.
- Internal identity management and all API authentication are automated, removing identity fields from user steps and outputs.
- Updated SKILL.md with concise overview tables, clearer separation of workflow steps, and improved organization of skill description, parameters, and examples.
- Simplified user-facing requirements: users only submit the relevant images or videos (file or URL) without handling identification parameters.
- Strengthened privacy and security instructions: identity details are never shown or requested from users; reports and results remain linked internally.
- Documentation and usage examples have been updated for clarity and to reflect the new internal identification logic.

smyx-elderly-facial-asymmetry-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for elderly facial asymmetry analysis using AI-based facial-landmark detection.
- Supports analysis of key facial asymmetry features (mouth corners, nasolabial folds, eyebrow lifts) from home camera images or videos.
- Calculates a facial asymmetry index (0–100%) and outputs risk level; alerts when risk exceeds threshold.
- Strict open-id workflow for each analysis or report query, ensuring user authentication and cloud data integrity.
- Can be scheduled periodically or triggered by observed abnormal behavior; integrates with smart cameras and health-management platforms.
- Provides structured history reports in Markdown table format for easy review and monitoring.
